authoring.measurementMethod: Actual corrective prop-v2 indexed source: independent height-slab joint envelopes, all five source views, original UV base-colour samples and seam topology. Joints inferred from actual surface interior; no mirrored old humanoid retarget, geometry creation or source transform.
authoring.anatomicalSides: Positive authored lateral axis is anatomical left, free hand. Negative lateral side is right, held dha. Joints independently measured; source is turned/asymmetric.
authoring.calibrationRequired: Exact rest export calibrates local axes/signs and nonzero downward upperRestRotation. Keep Sword/Hand local added rotation zero so original sculpted grasp moves together. Parent owns any integration placement/facing correction.
authoring.propMaskMethod: Blade original vertices plus bounded actual hilt corridor and existing UV gold cues. Remaining sculpted fingers/occluded grip are rigid HandR. Sword attaches directly to HandR: fixed child transforms make the whole held assembly deform equivalently; this does not prove perfect contact.
authoring.weightRevision: v2: actual indexed forearm components below source 1.20m remove forearm-guard vertices from torso/waist masks. Continuous measured elbow/wrist and upper-arm-to-Body transitions. Exact 17 bound bones, motion, original sword/hand/sole pins preserved.
